channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Gautama Buddha — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-17
item.description: “Hatred does not cease through hatred at any time. Hatred ceases through love. This is an unalterable law.” — Gautama Buddha

item.title: Mary Shelley — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-16
item.description: “I ought to be thy Adam, but I am rather the fallen angel, whom thou drivest from joy for no misdeed.” — Mary Shelley

item.title: Rumi — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-15
item.description: “Why do you stay in prison, when the door is so wide open?” — Rumi

item.title: Charlotte Perkins Gilman — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-14
item.description: “Let us revere, let us worship, but erect and open-eyed, the highest, not the lowest; the future, not the past!” — Charlotte Perkins Gilman

item.title: Cicero — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-13
item.description: “The shifts of fortune test the reliability of friends.” — Cicero

item.title: Thich Nhat Hanh — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-12
item.description: “Drink your tea slowly and reverently, as if it is the axis on which the world earth revolves.” — Thich Nhat Hanh

item.title: Rumi — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-11
item.description: “Let the beauty of what you love be what you do.” — Rumi

item.title: René Descartes — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-10
item.description: “I think, therefore I am.” — René Descartes
